La Jolla.name: La Jolla
La Jolla.description: Coastal science-and-affluence district with biotech labs, low-rise multifamily, and high-value residential redevelopment.

Mira Mesa.name: Mira Mesa
Mira Mesa.description: Tech-corridor residential plateau with steady infill, office-to-residential conversions, and planning-permit activity.

Pacific Beach.name: Pacific Beach
Pacific Beach.description: Beach-adjacent rental district with multifamily infill, short-term-rental churn, and steady interior renovation.

Ocean Beach.name: Ocean Beach
Ocean Beach.description: Bohemian coastal village with modest single-family rehab, cottage infill, and long-standing neighborhood retail.

Downtown.name: Downtown
Downtown.description: CBD and East Village high-rise pipeline — office, hospitality, residential towers, and the densest permitting in the metro.

North Park.name: North Park
North Park.description: Urban-village commercial corridor with dense multifamily infill, adaptive reuse, and steady mixed-use permitting.

Kearny Mesa.name: Kearny Mesa
Kearny Mesa.description: Auto-row and light-industrial district with warehouse conversions, commercial buildouts, and logistics infill.

Mission Valley.name: Mission Valley
Mission Valley.description: River-valley corridor of large mixed-use and commercial redevelopment along the transit spine.

Logan Heights.name: Logan Heights
Logan Heights.description: Historic barrio east of downtown with community-driven infill, ADU programs, and small commercial renewal.

Encanto.name: Encanto
Encanto.description: Inner-southeast residential district with single-family rehab, ADU activity, and modest retail reinvestment.

Otay Mesa.name: Otay Mesa
Otay Mesa.description: Border industrial and logistics mesa with warehouse construction, distribution centers, and border-economy churn.

San Ysidro.name: San Ysidro
San Ysidro.description: Border gateway neighborhood with mixed-use infill around the port of entry and steady small-commercial permits.
